title: Building a tactile physics merge puzzle with AI assistance: Petri Panic [Android]
author: DEVpissycatstudio
selftext:
Hey everyone!

I wanted to share my new mobile game, Petri Panic, built with the assistance of generative AI.

The Concept:
Instead of typical gravity-drop merge puzzles, players use a cotton swab tool with fluid touch physics to push and merge squishy bacteria inside a circular petri dish while fending off hungry slimes.

How AI assisted the process:
- Assisted in brainstorming evolutionary bacteria tiers and funny micro-celebrity lore.
- Helped iterate on 2D collision balancing and level design across 20 themed laboratories.
- Generated visual concepts and audio/sound effect directions.

Features:
- 100% playable offline
- No pay-to-win mechanics
- 100 handcrafted levels

It's live for free on Google Play (search 'Petri Panic' or link in first comment).
I'd love to hear how other developers here are balancing AI tools with core physics/feel programming!
